hero.title: We Started Within This Community.
hero.description:
In the U.S., there are many housing and public benefit programs for low-income families.
But language barriers, complex procedures, and not knowing where to ask for help
leave many Korean families without the support they deserve.

HapVi Together was founded in the LA Korean community
to close that gap.

As our name says - Happy Village Together -
we begin by building a better village together.

mission.label: Mission
mission.textLine1: Help Korean families in LA overcome language and information barriers,
mission.textLine2: so they can fully access U.S. housing support and government benefits.

vision.label: Vision
vision.textLine1: A community where every Korean family can start with stable housing,
